title: Yummy Syrian Lentils Stew
description: A dense, citrusy lentil stew infused with shoyu-koji and ferment-jang for a savory depth, perfect for a macrobiotic solo dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic, sautéing until translucent and fragrant.
Stir in the diced carrot and cook for 3 minutes, then add the red lentils and brown them slightly.
Pour in the vegetable broth and water, then fold in the shoyu-koji and ferment-jang, stirring to combine.
Add the lemon zest, salt, and black pepper, bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer the stew uncovered for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender and the broth has thickened.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then stir in the chopped cilantro just before serving.
Serve hot in individual bowls, optionally garnishing with a drizzle of extra olive oil.
